svg.title: Ice Stream: A Bilibili-style video and live-streaming platform: adaptive HLS, danmaku and browser or OBS broadcasting, built as Go microservices on Kubernetes.
svg.desc: Stack: Go, Gin, gRPC, NATS, Oracle, FFmpeg, React, Kubernetes. 7 gRPC services. 300+ Go tests. 180+ frontend tests. 5 streaming protocols.

g.text: A Bilibili-style video and live-streaming platform: adaptive HLS, danmaku and browser
